thread:
Maya Patel: FYI — Legal flagged the Starter tier for deprecation next quarter. We need a migration path for low-usage customers that doesn't blow up CS or ops.
Dylan Xu: Oof. Do we have a rough count of affected accounts? (low touch vs strategic)
Maya Patel: ~8.2k accounts total, ~7.6k below $200/mo (mostly hobbyists). ~600 are paying small teams. Data in /dw/usage_by_tier.
Kavita Rao: Recommend two tracks: automated self-serve migration with credit incentives, plus a manual handoff for the 600 small teams. Keep the former <30s UX.
Leo Chen: Agree. For automated migration, propose mapping Starter -> Essentials with a one-time 3-month credit and a soft cap on compute for 90 days.
Dylan Xu: What does Essentials include? We need to ensure token limits/embedding quotas don't break common flows.
Kavita Rao: Essentials = current Starter features + bumped rate limits; difference is metering/limits and optional add-ons. We'll need a temporary grace quota: +20% tokens for 90d.
Maya Patel: For transparency, email + in-console banner 60/30/14 days out. Subject line: "Action required: changes to your Redwood Starter plan". Draft copy in #product-assets.
pm-bot: Reminder: legal requires 30-day notice for paid-tier changes per TOS. Please attach legal approval doc when finalizing.
Dylan Xu: Implementation note: automation should be idempotent. Pseudocode for migration task:
```
for acct in affected:
  if acct.opt_out: continue
  acct.tier = "Essentials"
  acct.credits += promo_credits
  apply_quota(acct, uplift=1.2, duration_days=90)
```
Kavita Rao: We should add an explicit opt-out and an easy refund/rollback path for the first 14 days. CS playbook with canned responses needed.
Leo Chen: What about contract customers who embedded Starter into quotes? Legal/RevOps needs a carve-out for signed contracts.
Maya Patel: Yes — exclude any account with a signed SLA/contract tag. PMs should own reaching out to those customers for negotiation.
Dylan Xu: Metrics to track: migration rate, opt-outs, CS tickets per 1k migrated, revenue delta. Set guardrails: if tickets > 2% within 7 days, pause automated migration.
Kavita Rao: Also add a monitoring rule: spike in latency/errors from Essentials after mass-migration. Ops to watch capacity and autoscale thresholds.
Maya Patel: Timeline proposal: draft plan -> legal review (1 week) -> engineering impl (2 sprints) -> pilot 1k accounts -> full rollout. Pilot should be opt-in via a beta flag.
Leo Chen: For pilot, pick accounts that have simple usage patterns (no long-running chat sessions, <500k tokens/mo). We can A/B test credits amount: 1 months vs 3 months.
Dylan Xu: One more: preserve historical billing SKUs for audit. We should not rewrite invoice history, only change future billing rows.
Kavita Rao: CS playbook outline: proactive message, migration summary, how to downgrade back, contact link, escalation flow. Put in #customer-success by EOD.
Maya Patel: OK. Action items:
- Dylan: export account list + tagging criteria (by EOD)
- Kavita: draft email + CS playbook (tomorrow)
- Leo: design migration job + rollback plan (this sprint)
- Maya: coordinate legal & RevOps carve-outs
Tagging: @dylan @kavita @leo
Dylan Xu: Got it. I'll start the export now. :rocket:
Kavita Rao: I'll post playbook draft in the channel when ready. :memo:
Leo Chen: I'll mock the migration job and post the schema for the quota uplift. :wrench:
pm-bot: Note: please run the compliance checklist before pilot.
